settings.custom_faq1_q: What is a vacuum erection device?
settings.custom_faq1_a: A vacuum erection device (VED) is an FDA-cleared, non-invasive medical device that uses gentle negative pressure to draw blood into the penis, creating a firm erection for intercourse or post-surgical penile rehabilitation.
settings.custom_faq2_a: No prescription is required to order ErecAid systems or accessories through our online store. All devices are FDA-cleared Class II medical systems approved for safe in-home use.
settings.custom_faq3_q: Should I choose a manual or automatic pump?
settings.custom_faq3_a: Manual pumps provide direct, tactile control without batteries. Automatic or rechargeable pumps offer effortless one-touch operation, which is ideal if you have arthritis or reduced grip strength.
settings.custom_faq4_q: What size tension ring do I need?
settings.custom_faq4_a: Complete ErecAid systems include multiple ring sizes (standard, medium, and large) so you can find the ideal balance of comfort and firmness for your anatomy. Replacement rings and sizing guides are also available.

settings.custom_faq6_a: Yes! Our knowledgeable product support team is available by phone at 866-496-7359 (Mon-Fri 8am-5pm CT) to answer any questions and assist you confidentially.
